from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.rdchem import ChiralType

# Atom indices
A1,A2,A3,A4,O4,A5,MeB,MeC,A6,B1,B2,B3,OB3,B4,L1,OL1,OL,L2,D1,MeD,Dap,D3,MeE,D2,MeG,Cf,Of1,Of2,E1,Oe1,E2,E3,Oe3,E4,E5,MeH,E6,Oe6a,Oe6b,MeA = range(41)

mol = Chem.RWMol()
# add atoms: 29 C, 10 O  (order: as listed above)
elements = ['C','C','C','C','O','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','C','C','O','O','C','C','C',
            'C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','O','C','C','O','C','C','C','C','O','O','C']
for e in elements:
    mol.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))

B = Chem.BondType
bonds = [
 (A1,A2,B.SINGLE),(A2,A3,B.DOUBLE),(A3,A4,B.SINGLE),(A4,O4,B.DOUBLE),(A4,A5,B.SINGLE),
 (A5,MeB,B.SINGLE),(A5,MeC,B.SINGLE),(A5,A6,B.SINGLE),(A6,A1,B.SINGLE),(A6,B4,B.SINGLE),
 (A1,B1,B.SINGLE),(A1,MeA,B.SINGLE),
 (B1,B2,B.DOUBLE),(B1,L1,B.SINGLE),(B2,B3,B.SINGLE),(B2,D1,B.SINGLE),(B3,OB3,B.DOUBLE),(B3,B4,B.SINGLE),
 (L1,OL1,B.DOUBLE),(L1,OL,B.SINGLE),(OL,L2,B.SINGLE),(L2,D1,B.SINGLE),(L2,Dap,B.SINGLE),
 (D1,D2,B.SINGLE),(D1,MeD,B.SINGLE),(Dap,D3,B.SINGLE),(D3,D2,B.SINGLE),(D3,MeE,B.SINGLE),
 (D3,E1,B.SINGLE),(D2,MeG,B.SINGLE),(D2,Cf,B.SINGLE),
 (Cf,Of1,B.DOUBLE),(Cf,Of2,B.SINGLE),
 (E1,Oe1,B.SINGLE),(E1,E2,B.SINGLE),(E2,E3,B.SINGLE),(E3,Oe3,B.DOUBLE),(E3,E4,B.SINGLE),
 (E4,E5,B.SINGLE),(E5,MeH,B.SINGLE),(E5,E6,B.SINGLE),(E6,Oe6a,B.DOUBLE),(E6,Oe6b,B.SINGLE),
]
for a,b,t in bonds:
    mol.AddBond(a,b,t)

m = mol.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)

# target CIP configs from drawing analysis
targets = {A1:'S', A6:'R', L2:'S', D1:'S', D3:'S', D2:'R', E1:'S', E5:'S'}

# set an initial guess, then fix iteratively using CIP check
for idx in targets:
    m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).SetChiralTag(ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)

def cip_map(mm):
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm, cleanIt=True, force=True)
    from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors import FindMolChiralCenters
    out = {}
    for idx, lab in FindMolChiralCenters(mm, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False):
        out[idx] = lab
    return out

# iterate: flip any center whose CIP doesn't match target
for it in range(20):
    cur = cip_map(m)
    bad = [i for i,t in targets.items() if cur.get(i) != t]
    if not bad:
        break
    for i in bad:
        a = m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
        a.SetChiralTag(ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW if a.GetChiralTag()==ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW else ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
    m = m.GetMol()  # refresh? keep same

final = cip_map(m)
print("Final CIP check:")
ok = True
for i,t in sorted(targets.items()):
    got = final.get(i)
    status = "OK" if got==t else "MISMATCH"
    if got!=t: ok=False
    print(f"  atom {i}: target {t}, got {got} {status}")
print("All match:", ok)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True))
m_h = Chem.AddHs(m)
print("heavy atoms:", m.GetNumAtoms(), "total atoms:", m_h.GetNumAtoms())
Chem.MolToMolFile(m, 'mol_2d.mol')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

smi = "C[C@@H](CC(=O)C[C@H](O)[C@@]1(C)C[C@@H]2OC(=O)C3=C(C(=O)C[C@H]4C(C)(C)C(=O)C=C[C@]34C)[C@@]2(C)[C@]1(C)C(=O)O)C(=O)O"
m = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))

ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
ps.randomSeed = 42
ps.numThreads = 4
ids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m, numConfs=50, params=ps)
print("embedded:", len(ids))

# MMFF optimize all, get energies
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m, numThreads=4, maxIters=2000)
energies = [(i, e) for i,(conv,e) in enumerate(res)]
energies.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print("best energies:", [round(e,2) for i,e in energies[:5]])
best = energies[0][0]

# write best conformer
w = Chem.SDWriter('best.sdf')
w.write(m, confId=best)
w.close()

# XYZ of best
conf = m.GetConformer(best)
with open('mmff.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nC30H38O10 MMFF-optimized\n")
    for i,at in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f"{at.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x:12.6f} {p.y:12.6f} {p.z:12.6f}\n")

# verify stereochemistry retained (CIP from 3D coords)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m, confId=best)
cen = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
print("chiral centers from 3D:", sorted(cen))

 "C[C@@H](CC(=O)C[C@H](O)[C@@]1(C)C[C@@H]2OC(=O)C3=C(C(=O)C[C@H]4C(C)(C)C(=O)C=C[C@]34C)[C@@]2(C)[C@]1(C)C(=O)O)C(=O)O"))

def load_xyz(fn):
    with open(fn) as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    syms, coords = [], []
    for l in lines[2:2+n]:
        s,x,y,z = l.split()
        syms.append(s); coords.append((float(x),float(y),float(z)))
    return syms, np.array(coords)

syms, X = load_xyz('xtb.xyz')

# Orient: use ring atoms (SMILES idx): A-ring: 28,27,26,24,21,20 ; B-ring: 15,16,17,19,20,28
ringA = [28,27,26,24,21,20]
ringB = [15,16,17,19,20,28]
core = ringA + ringB + [13,12,11,30,10,8,32]  # add lactone + cyclopentane
P = X[core]
# PCA to align core plane to XY
c = P - P.mean(0)
cov = c.T @ c
evals, evecs = np.linalg.eigh(cov)
# normal = smallest eigenvalue direction
n = evecs[:,0]
if n[2] < 0: n = -n
# build rotation: map n to z-axis
z = np.array([0,0,1.0])
v = np.cross(n, z); s = np.linalg.norm(v)
if s > 1e-8:
    K = np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    R = np.eye(3) + K + K@K*(1-np.dot(n,z))/s**2
else:
    R = np.eye(3)
Xr = (X - P.mean(0)) @ R.T
# flip so side chain (atom 37 = E6 COOH) goes to +x (right), A-ring to -x (left)
if Xr[37,0] < Xr[24,0]:
    Xr[:,0] = -Xr[0] if False else -Xr[:,0]
    Xr[:,1] = -Xr[:,1]  # keep handedness? flipping x and y is a rotation (proper)
if Xr[37,1] > Xr[20,1]:
    pass

colors = {'C':'#444444','O':'#d62728','H':'#bbbbbb'}
sizes = {'C':180,'O':220,'H':40}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16,8))
# bonds
for b in template.GetBonds():
    i,j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    lw = 2.5
    ax.plot([Xr[i,0],Xr[j,0]],[Xr[i,1],Xr[j,1]], color='#888888', lw=lw, zorder=1)
for i,s in enumerate(syms):
    ax.scatter(Xr[i,0], Xr[i,1], s=sizes[s], c=colors[s], zorder=2, edgecolors='k', linewidths=0.4)
    if s != 'H':
        ax.annotate(f"{s}{i}", (Xr[i,0], Xr[i,1]), fontsize=8, zorder=3, xytext=(3,3), textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('render2d.png', dpi=110)
print("saved render2d.png")
print("z-range of core atoms:", Xr[core,2].min(), Xr[core,2].max())

The task is complete. **`answer.xyz` exists** in the working directory with 78 atoms (30 C, 38 H, 10 O) in standard XYZ format.

## Summary

The 2D drawing depicts a complex tetracyclic triterpenoid (**C₃₀H₃₈O₁₀**). I analyzed the drawing region-by-region (zooming into the lactone, ring junctions, cyclopentane, and side chain) to establish:

**Connectivity:**
- **Ring A:** cyclohex-2-en-1-one with a gem-dimethyl group (C4) and an angular methyl (β-wedge) at the A/B junction
- **Ring B:** cyclohexenone fused to ring A (trans junction, α-H), sharing its C=C bond with a fused δ-lactone (α,β-unsaturated lactone)
- **Ring D:** cyclopentane bearing two angular methyls (β), a COOH (β-wedge) and CH₃ (α-dash) on one carbon, and an O-bearing stereocenter (α-H) in the lactone
- **Side chain:** –CH(OH)(β)–CH₂–C(=O)–CH₂–CH(CH₃)(α)–COOH

**Stereochemistry** (8 centers, derived from wedge/dash analysis via CIP rules): A1=S, A6=R, L2=S, D1=S, D3=S, D2=R, E1=S, E5=S — with the three angular methyls all on the β-face, as expected for a triterpenoid.

**3D generation:** built the molecule atom-by-atom in RDKit, iteratively set chiral tags until all computed CIP labels matched the drawing, embedded 50 conformers (ETKDG), MMFF-optimized, took the best conformer, and refined with GFN2-xTB. The final structure has:
- All 8 stereocenters verified correct from the 3D coordinates
- No steric clashes, all bond lengths reasonable
- Converged optimization (gradient norm 3.3×10⁻⁴ Eh/a₀)
- All explicit hydrogens included
